title: OCR region ground truth
description: Annotate selected regions rather than transcribing every page. Placed in ocr-benchmark/labels/ocr-region/<docId>-p<NN>.json. `textType` is what makes CER-by-text-type answerable; without it the OCR metrics collapse to one undifferentiated number.

fullPageTranscript.description: Optional whole-page verbatim text. When present, page-level CER/WER become available for this page.

bbox.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalized, origin top-left, ORIGINAL render frame

verbatimText.description: Exact transcription. Do not correct spelling, expand abbreviations, or normalize digits.

isCorrected.description: Struck through or overwritten on the document
